plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Integrated harness: enforces the user's Claude rules at the tool call (git/worktree/delete/venv/port/Linear/memory guards, merge-and-release gate, report lint), plus session tooling and workflow automation.

plugins.name: model-tier
plugins.description: Routes each main-loop turn to opus, sonnet or haiku by task complexity, with a set_tier tool the model can call to correct itself

plugins.name: auto-claude
plugins.description: Unattended run of a repository, to the end state live: Claude plans the long-term goal, milestones and deploy; the built-in loop builds each in a worktree and judges it; auto-claude pushes, opens PRs, merges when CI is green, deploys and smoke-checks, and a watchdog repairs or routes around stalls until the final check passes.

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Enforces the architecture a repository declares in .claude/architecture.json at Edit/Write (layer direction, forbidden imports), notes code smells with the refactoring to apply, and ships a refactoring.guru-keyed catalog and /arch audit.
